changelog: Aura AI v2.4.2 — Comprehensive Performance, Voice Lifecycle, Recents Dismissal, In-Built Browser & Bridge Hardening
Top-Bar Switching & Drawer Freeze Elimination: Keyboard dismiss before navigation drawer open/mode switch, optimized recompositions
Accurate Recents Dismissal: Swipe-up app card removal and bottom X button support with verification; zero false success confirmations
Accessibility & Direct Text Injection: Reliable direct text injection and UI tree reading without requesting screen share
Complete Voice Lifecycle: 6 explicit states (Connecting, Speak to ask idle, Listening, Thinking, Working, Speaking) with smooth transitions
Voice Session Room/SQLite Persistence: Live real-time two-way synchronization between Voice Mode and Chat thread database
In-Built Browser Routing: Opening websites and YouTube launches directly inside Aura internal browser tab instead of external Chrome
New Chat & Blank Screen Fix: Instant direct New Chat creation via voice/top bar without white screen flash or empty state glitch
Antigravity Bridge Hardening: Eliminated persistent red disconnected banner; exponential backoff, atomic reconnect, and background lifecycle pause
